decisions: Retain explicit product defaults/type maps and synchronous commit notification ownership; do not replace them with a reflective schema platform. Separate current profile capture from one-time migration.
Keep BankData borrowed arrays read-only by contract; copy a selected puzzle before mutation, avoid whole-bank deep copies.
Keep inexpensive generation guards on independent public cache entry points; no measured reason to remove them.
Single child close may await hide. Bulk/owner disposal synchronously runs destroy hooks, without awaiting animations.
No general page state machine added; explicit entry readiness guards actual inputs and common business creation.
limits: Failed reward events retained in process memory; persistent write failure followed by process death cannot restore unpersisted evidence.
Native rewarded callback lacks a per-show ID; existing late-reward association policy is unchanged.
ContentValidation is an explicit internal API change; callers must pass the three-callback contract instead of an implicit bound Callable.
Real mobile export, touch/performance, production CDN/TLS, native SDK and visual acceptance remain unverified.
Save validation checks persisted structure; domain/session validators still own business validity. No exhaustive timing or platform claim.
